description:
The idle spin-down mechanism (bedrock-q67.21.5, PRs #193/#194) is fully built but dormant: nothing in production sets the "idle_timeout" worker param (PR #193 audit F4, deferred deliberately). Decide and wire the config source: a cluster-config knob handed through the director's recruitment_ctx as worker_params (the plumbing already exists — Recruitment.create_materializer_worker merges worker_params and always overrides shard_id), plus a default policy. The opt-in shape keeps the system shard exempt by construction (bootstrap never sets params). Options: ship off-by-default with the knob documented, or pick a conservative default (e.g. 15m) for data shards.

Also carries the q67.21.4/.5 observability residuals, neither blocking:
- N2: covered-before-caught-up telemetry breadcrumb — a freshly recruited materializer is published as covered while still drinking its stream suffix.
- Placeholder fit: repo traffic parks ~50ms per attempt (builder fetch timeout) with the repo backoff loop doing the waiting; consider a hold-aware fetch timeout for known-placeholder routes; decide with measurements.
title: Production wiring for materializer idle_timeout
